title: Add VPC control plane provisioning Terraform module: subnets, endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: add a reusable Terraform module and installer integration to provision the Private Control Plane VPC resources required for Redwood Private deployments. This PR implements subnet creation (public/private), interface and gateway endpoints for S3/ECR/SSM, security group templates and least-privilege rules for control-plane-to-worker communication, cross-account VPC peering for control plane access, and Route53 private hosted zone + resolver rules for internal DNS. The change is broken into a Terraform module (terraform/vpc-control-plane), Helm values & installer hooks to consume the outputs, and docs/migration notes. Includes automated validation steps and e2e smoke tests against an isolated AWS account. Checklist: [1] Terraform module with inputs/outputs and examples, [2] security review of SG rules, [3] docs and upgrade notes, [4] CI terraform plan/apply in sandbox, [5] helm values + installer integration, [6] rollback instructions. Backwards compatibility: module outputs are additive; existing on-prem installs are unaffected unless opt-in. Related work: Linear ENG-1874 and PM-402. See linked SUP-913 for a customer request that triggered cross-account peering support. CI: initial terraform fmt/lint caught minor formatting issues; corrected in second commit. Testing: unit tests for Terraform module variables, CI plan runs in a sandbox account, manual end-to-end validation of VPC peering and DNS resolution between control plane and private worker VPCs. Merge notes: squash-merge, tagged release candidate.

release_notes:
- Add terraform module terraform/vpc-control-plane to provision private control plane VPC resources (subnets, endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53).
- Installer integration: new helm values and installer hook to consume module outputs.
- Migration notes for existing private deployments: opt-in module outputs and rollback steps included.
migration_notes: To adopt: run terraform apply in a sandbox account using examples/basic, confirm outputs, update installer helm values to point to the created VPC outputs, then run installer upgrade. Rollback: installer supports an opt-out flag and terraform destroy will remove module resources; follow documented peering acceptance revocation steps.
security_review: Security reviewed SG rules and endpoint policies. SGs default to deny except explicit control-plane ports (TLS/HTTPS and internal RPC ports). Endpoint policies restrict S3/ECR access to deployed account prefixes. Cross-account peering requires an explicit IAM role and manual acceptance by the peer account.
merge_notes: Squash-merged after CI passed and approval from infra/security. Tagged release candidate: v0.12.0-rc1.
notes_for_operators: When deploying in production, ensure route propagation on route tables is enabled and monitor CloudWatch VPC Flow logs during initial rollout. If using overlapping CIDRs, set create_route53=false and configure custom DNS peering.
